authorization_basis: User instruction to freeze the evidence contract and proceed with P0; no scientific/rights/adjudication approval is inferred.
unit: One atomic claim made in one identifiable scholarly document version, with a locatable body passage.
wikipedia_role: Term/person/reference discovery only; its assertions are not the default candidate-claim corpus.
selection: Purposive feasibility pilot of 20-30 body-level scholarly claims. Not representative; no prevalence, majority-literature or historical-first estimate.
priority: Attribution of naming, chronology, eponymic inspiration, conceptual development, empirical contributions and authorship, with roles kept separate.
source_statement_vs_truth: SOURCE_ASSERTS(document_version, candidate) records what a scholarly source claims. It does not establish the underlying historical or empirical proposition.
compound_example: Split the supplied coining/person/year/name-origin sentence into separate propositions. Birth/death years belong to identity assertions. The supplied wording is an unattributed lead until located in a particular scholarly source.
non_exclusivity: An assertion naming Merton is not automatically an assertion of sole coining. A joint-authorship reflection does not automatically prove joint naming.
local_first: Deterministic local PDF reading/indexing precedes bounded local-model drafting. Main-model review is restricted to contracts, ambiguous attribution and selected outputs. No paid/proprietary API fallback.
private_intake_boundary: This analyst intake retains NOT_REVIEWED rights and PENDING transcription review and is not yet L37-conforming. Manual operation and private storage do not satisfy that permission gate. Do not promote further processing or unattended operation without the affirmative exact-operation rights decision; no PDF/text redistribution or scientific release is permitted.
review: All intake assessments remain null/NOT_ASSESSED. Require two independent human annotations and an adjudicator for disagreements before accepted historical findings or gold.
human_source_handoff: One bounded access attempt. Access denial, paywall, challenge or unapproved redirect creates a source request; do not invent passages or silently substitute versions.
projection_boundary: The P0 JSON format is a typed intake projection with local candidate IDs, not full dictionary entity records/UUIDs. Promotion requires explicit record construction, exact references and independent review.
public_sync_scope: Code, frozen contracts, synthetic tests, English documentation and SKILLS. Actual source files, extracted text, raw local-model output and candidate evidence remain private pending reviewed export.
